tasks.prompt: Implement step1(value): trim and case-fold a boolean string, returning true for true, false for false, and null for anything else.
tasks.solution: export function step1(value) { const text = value.trim().toLowerCase(); return text === 'true' ? true : text === 'false' ? false : null; }

tasks.prompt: Implement step2(value): decode form text, treating plus as space before percent decoding. Return null on malformed percent encoding.
tasks.solution: export function step2(value) { try { return decodeURIComponent(value.replaceAll('+', ' ')); } catch { return null; } }

tasks.prompt: Implement step3(value): escape HTML text ampersands, less-than and greater-than without double-escaping newly generated entities.
Implement step4(value): use the existing form decoder and then HTML escaping. Return null if decoding fails. Preserve all earlier APIs.
tasks.solution: export function step4(value) { const decoded = step2(value); return decoded === null ? null : step3(decoded); }

tasks.prompt: Implement step1([value, minimum, maximum]): clamp a finite value into a closed interval; invalid numbers or reversed bounds return null.
tasks.solution: export function step1([value, minimum, maximum]) { return [value, minimum, maximum].every(Number.isFinite) && minimum <= maximum ? Math.min(maximum, Math.max(minimum, value)) : null; }

tasks.prompt: Implement step2([first, last]): inclusive integer sum with both endpoints; invalid or reversed integer bounds return null.
tasks.solution: export function step2([first, last]) { return Number.isSafeInteger(first) && Number.isSafeInteger(last) && first <= last ? (first + last) * (last - first + 1) / 2 : null; }

tasks.prompt: Implement step3(values): return the median of a nonempty finite numeric array without mutating its input; invalid input returns null.
tasks.solution: export function step3(values) { if (!values.length || !values.every(Number.isFinite)) return null; const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b); const middle = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2); return sorted.length % 2 ? sorted[middle] : (sorted[middle - 1] + sorted[middle]) / 2; }

tasks.prompt: Implement step4(values): calculate the existing median and clamp it into [0,10]; empty or invalid input returns null. Preserve all earlier APIs.
tasks.solution: export function step4(values) { const median = step3(values); return median === null ? null : step1([median, 0, 10]); }

tasks.prompt: Implement step1(value): trim, lowercase and join whitespace-separated words with hyphens, preserving Unicode letters.
Implement step2(values): remove duplicate strings stably using case-insensitive comparison; preserve the first original spelling.
tasks.solution: export function step2(values) { const seen = new Set(); return values.filter(value => { const key = value.toLowerCase(); if (seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true; }); }

tasks.prompt: Implement step3(records): sort records by ascending numeric priority, preserving input order for ties without mutating the input.
tasks.solution: export function step3(records) { return [...records].sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority); }

tasks.prompt: Implement step4(values): normalize each value with step1, then remove duplicates with step2. Preserve the original order and earlier APIs.
